# Sample Virtue

> A made-up epigraph line about patience — Invented Sutra 1.1

Patience is taught here as the **steady habit** of answering harm without returning it. See [[Sample Figure|the teacher]] and [[Sample Figure#The Journey]] and [[Sample Figure]], plus [[Missing Note]].

![[embedded-diagram.png]]

## 🌿 Core Teaching

The teaching is short. It has a second sentence. A third sentence follows here.

> [!quote] On patience
> *"Hatred is never ended by hatred, only by patience."* — Invented Sutra 4.2, verse 5

> [!quote] *"The wise bend like grass and do not break."*
> — Made-up Commentary, chapter 3

> [!tip] Remember
> Practice with small irritations first.

> [!note] A side point
> - Patience is not passivity
> - Patience needs attention

## ✨ Practice ✨

Sit, breathe, and count slowly. Return to the count when the mind wanders.

### 🔸 Daily Habit

Begin each morning with one minute of quiet.
